title: IVG Pro 12 Sour Cherry Watermelon Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Sour Cherry Watermelon IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods combine the juicy sweetness of fresh Watermelon with the tart edge of Sour Cherry for a lively fruit fusion. The contrasting notes work in harmony to deliver a bright, candy-like flavour that’s both sweet and tangy. Each refill pack contains a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid and a 10ml refill reservoir. Once connected, the system automatically feeds the pod as you vape, eliminating the need for refills or coil changes. Mesh coil technology ensures consistent flavour and smooth vapour production, while the click-fit design keeps setup fast and clean. Designed exclusively for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
